reviews.title: Best motherboard? Miku motherboard.
reviews.comment: This is a great motherboard! The "Miku tax" is not too excessive, although it is a tiny bit pricier motherboard, it is loaded with features. The most similar board to this one is only about $60 cheaper but you have to chalk that up to the "Miku tax" which I would gladly pay just for the POST loading screen with Hatsune Miku welcoming you each time you boot up your computer. In addition to that, the actual bios is also Miku themed. The quick m.2 slots are also super convenient and easy to use. The extras included like the stickers and acrylic phone stand are also a great addition. Only drawback I would say is that the chipset does require Windows 11 for the bluetooth and Wifi to work properly as the wireless card they're using in this board only has W11 drivers available. Definitely would recommend this board, it has been super stable, and it looks amazing!
reviews.author: Swats

reviews.title: Good miku motherboard
reviews.comment: It’s working great so far, I haven’t had any issues with it. The installation process is the same as any standard ATX motherboard, so it was straightforward and easy to set up. The overall look and design are very cute and aesthetically pleasing. I’m really happy with it.
